_comment: Tune per project. Categories map to severity: 'error' fails the run, 'warn' reports only. Ignore patterns are matched against the MATCHED SPAN, not the line; add project-specific ones (build numbers, SKUs) to 'ignore'. The linter REFUSES a catch-all ignore, an all-'warn' severity map, or an unrecognised severity value: a config may narrow a false positive, it may not disable detection.
